intended_object: The right C-comodule structure on N with coaction ρ, induced by a coaction-compatible injective linear map i : N → M into a C-comodule M (the subcomodule structure pulled back along an equivariant inclusion). Inferred from the docstring and name, analogous to Mathlib's Function.Injective.* structure-transfer constructors.
explanation: The coaction is set to the given ρ. Coassociativity is proved by applying i ⊗ id_{C⊗C}, which is assumed injective, and using naturality of the associator, the compatibility (i⊗id)∘ρ = coact∘i, and coassociativity in M. The counit law is proved via the right unitor and injectivity of i. These hypotheses are exactly what is needed without flatness, as the docstring says. Everything is stated over an arbitrary commutative semiring, coalgebra and modules, matching the generality of the library's own Comodule class; Mathlib has no comodule class, hence no counterpart. The construction correctly yields the intended comodule structure at its natural generality.
